content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Five-Step Path to CAPM Certification

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or global equivalent) and formal project management education—but no prior work experience. If you hold a diploma and are ready to formalize your PM knowledge, you meet the baseline requirement to pursue certification.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format covers the PMBOK Guide and exam domains across a condensed schedule, letting you earn your required contact hours without lengthy evening classes or weeks of part-time study.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, submit your official PMI application and pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process to ensure all documentation is complete and your eligibility is verified before exam scheduling.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce key concepts. When you're ready, schedule your proctored CAPM exam and demonstrate mastery of project management fundamentals.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or additional training. Granite PM Academy offers resources to help you sustain and grow your credential over time.
